notes: ASC 360-10-35-43/45: on classification the asset is measured at the lower of carrying amount ($55000) and fair value less cost to sell ($45000), and depreciation ceases. Subsequent gains are recognized only to the extent of cumulative losses previously recognized under the HFS model, so the Dec 31 Year 2 increase in FV-CTS from $45000 to $49000 ($4000) is fully recognized because cumulative impairment was $10000; carrying amount is capped by the $55000 ceiling (carrying amount at classification, unadjusted since no depreciation would have been taken). Write-downs are carried in a valuation allowance rather than credited directly to the asset, so cost and accumulated depreciation are both removed at disposal. Disposal: net cash $48500 vs. carrying amount $49000 gives a $500 loss on sale.
